label: 相对父件摆放
description: 把 child 按「相对 parent 的局部位姿」摆好：child.origin = parent.origin + R(parent.rpy)·offset，child.rpy = parent.rpy ∘ rpy。复合在编译期完成并用绝对位姿写回 child part，不生成 joint —— 静态路（无 joint）的建筑就靠它表达窗嵌墙洞 / 门框嵌墙洞 / 门扇挂门框这类只能相对父件表达的位置。链式可用：先把门框摆到墙上，再把门扇摆到门框上。要做真正可开合的门窗才写 joint(type="revolute")，那会让整栋楼回到 URDF 路。
description-en: Place a child at a pose expressed RELATIVE to its parent: child.origin = parent.origin + R(parent.rpy)·offset and child.rpy = parent.rpy ∘ rpy. The composition happens at compile time and is written back as the child's absolute pose — no joint is created, so the model stays on the static path. This is how jointless buildings express the poses that can only be stated relative to a parent (window in a wall opening, door frame in a wall opening, door leaf on a frame). Chains work: place the frame on the wall, then the leaf on the frame. Use joint(type="revolute") only when the door/window must actually open — that puts the whole building back on the URDF path.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.label: 几何
inputs.description: 上游 Geometry（必须含 parent 与 child 两件）

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.label: 父部件 id
inputs.description: 父 part id（读它的 origin/rpy 作为参考系）；也可填 shape id，没有 part 包它时自动补一行
inputs.description-en: Parent part id (its origin/rpy is the reference frame); a shape id is also accepted and auto-wrapped.

inputs.name: child_id
inputs.label: 子部件 id
inputs.description: 子 part id；其 origin/rpy 会被改写成复合后的绝对位姿
inputs.description-en: Child part id; its origin/rpy is rewritten to the composed absolute pose.

inputs.name: ox
inputs.label: 局部偏移 X
inputs.description: 相对父件坐标系的偏移 X（米）
inputs.description-en: Offset X in the parent's frame (m).

inputs.name: oy
inputs.label: 局部偏移 Y
inputs.description: 相对父件坐标系的偏移 Y（米）
inputs.description-en: Offset Y in the parent's frame (m).

inputs.name: oz
inputs.label: 局部偏移 Z
inputs.description: 相对父件坐标系的偏移 Z（米）
inputs.description-en: Offset Z in the parent's frame (m).

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 改写过 child.origin/rpy 后的新 Geometry，可直接接下一条 place_local / QC / 导出
outputs.description-en: New Geometry with the child's origin/rpy rewritten; chain straight into another place_local / QC / export.

outputs.name: origin
outputs.label: 世界原点
outputs.description: 写回 child 的绝对 origin [x,y,z]（米）
outputs.description-en: Absolute origin [x,y,z] (m) written back to the child.

outputs.name: rpy
outputs.label: 世界 rpy
outputs.description: 写回 child 的绝对 rpy [r,p,y]（弧度）
outputs.description-en: Absolute rpy [r,p,y] (rad) written back to the child.

outputs.name: note
outputs.label: 提示
outputs.description: 非致命提示（例如同一 Geometry 里还有 joint，说明两套装配写法混用了）
outputs.description-en: Non-fatal note (e.g. the same geometry also has joints, i.e. two assembly styles are mixed).

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: 错误
outputs.description: 缺件 / 非法参数 / 自我摆放时的错误说明
outputs.description-en: Error message for a missing part, a bad argument, or placing a part onto itself.
